findings.summary: The help button shows only "?"; its accessible name, "Help with delivery windows", is clear, but sighted first-time users cannot tell what help it offers.
findings.fix: Optional: a visible label or tooltip, "What do the windows mean?".

findings.summary: The capture does not show what happens after Save; the confirmation is outside this state.
findings.fix: Check the saved state's capture when it is reviewed.

personas.note: After one Tab the select shows a 2 px blue outline; Tab order is select, Save, help.
Heading, labelled combobox with three options, and two named buttons.
Body and label text are dark grey on white (about 7:1); controls are 44 px tall.
